title: Living Room Design Ideas with Tiles and Surfaces
htmlContent:
By definition the term living room, the focal point of most homes, is where life happens we relax and have fun,  where family and friends gather, and that special place that we want to feel comfortable in. The appropriate use of all the various tiles and surfaces that are available can make such a difference to the style and atmosphere of the living room you choose. This article looks at inspiring living room design ideas that use the different tiles and surfaces to make your living room a practical yet attractive home.

Choosing the Right Tiles for Living Room Floors

 

Choose the right living room floor tiles for your space. Choosing living room floor tiles to suit the style of your home interior can be difficult, but it is an important choice to make. Every room for example the living room‘s interior design starts with the floor and the look of your room. Certain sort of living room tile will make the living room look spacious, luxurious or cheerful with a modern living room with the use of lively looking tiles, it is worth to look at this alluring collection.

When selecting floor tiles, paramount considerations include:

Consideration

Impact

Durability

Long-term wear and tear

Maintenance

Ease of cleaning and upkeep

Complement to furniture and decor

Overall aesthetic harmony

Types of Floor Tiles: Pros and Cons

 

If you are decorating your living room,  it‘s worthwhile knowing about all sorts of tiles, including their advantages and disadvantages,  so that you can choose the perfect version for your modern home. Ceramic tiles, for instance, are an affordable, fashionable and popular option,  which give a range of designs and can simulate the style of natural stone, but they are more susceptible to chips. On the other hand, natural stone tiles are more costly and require a little more maintenance, but they create a level of elegance that you can‘t get on any other design. Natural stone and ceramic tiles each have their own pros and cons though,  and you should think about everything from appearance to practicality when choosing one for your home.

Stylish Vitrified Tiles for Modern Living Rooms

 

If you are after a modern look to your living room then trendy vitrified tiles are the ideal option and do lend themselves to modern design. With thousands of different finishes from the lustrous and trendy matt to all manner of bright colors and modern designs,  there is a multitude of design ideas that you can find using these types of tiles. Modern homes and living rooms are most often designed with smooth continuous finishes and as such modern vitrified tiles are one of the more popular choices for a contemporary living space. Modern vitrified tiles are uniform in texture and offer a more modern appearance to any living room floor.

Natural Stone Tiles: A Timeless Choice

 

Natural Stone tiles;  such as marble, granite, or travertine,  are an elegant natural material that can add an element of prestige and character to any modern living room; ideal for use as living room floor tiles. Each natural stone tile will have its own natural veining and variations in color,  no two installations will be alike ensuring an air of prestige and exclusivity. Though a little more high maintenance than engineered tiles for living, natural stone tiles are a highly durable option; able to take foot traffic and wear;  and, as such, should prove a worthy investment. The natural texture and tones of natural stone tiles create a calm but sophisticated natural aesthetic for any modern interior.

Creating Texture with Tiles in Living Rooms

 

Textured Tiles: Adding Dimension to Your Space

Choosing textured tiles to decorate your modern living room interior design is a perfect way to add some depth to the space and ensure a more intriguing overall effect in contrast to the typical flat surfaces of standard modern living areas.  The range of which textured room tile designs can be created allows for a wide variety of tactile experiences,  with the added aesthetic call of design intricacies,  transforming a plain wall or floor into an eye catching feature.  Variations in the reliefs can be obvious or subtle,  flat or rounded, but whatever you prefer,  the appearance of textured wall tiles in your design scheme will have a dramatic impact and add a polished modern touch to your home decor. Light textures have also been shown to reflect the light well and emphasize natural oblique light reflections.

Wall Texture Design: Enhancing Your Living Room Aesthetics

So, be creative and introduce a well designed wall texture in your living rooms that will add a personality to them that cant by achieved with the floor tile alone.  Some sophisticated living room wall coverings can act as a wonderful backdrop to the furniture and adornments and some will look great in their own right as a feature.  Depending on its texture, a tile with a matte finish of subtle depth or even a more complex pattern,  floor tiles come in many variations resulting in a range of ideas for your living room and the design possibilities by using different collections,  vitrifiedfloor or bigger floor tiles to create a unique wall texture, making your living room an exquisite interior.

Accent Walls: Focal Points with Room Tile Designs

Accent walls are an effective approach in bringing creative elements to modern living room designs. Incorporating one or more accent walls with bold and innovative room tile designs in a living room is sure to make a visual impact in the living space. Selecting the ideal living room tile for accent walls such as a tile that offers intriguing texture, color or geometric shape can make the accent wall an eye-catching piece that pulls the eye of anyone who visits. One can experiment with various tiles for living, perhaps pairing a subtle textured wall with a snazzy modern wall design or perhaps natural stones in classic styles.  Incorporating living room wall tiles as accent walls will turn an ordinary wall into an eye-catching décor piece that adds to the overall interior of a space and will certainly add wow factor to your modern living room and hall areas.

Modern Living Room Tile Design Ideas

 

Trendy Color Schemes for Stylish Interiors

When choosing a floor or wall tile for a contemporary living room, the color scheme of the tiles will be key to bringing the room together with a beautiful contemporary home interior.  The most fashionable color schemes tend to be soft neutral shades like gentle greys,  buttery beiges and the more traditional whites which brings in plenty of light, look good by themselves and are forgiving when it comes to choosing furniture and accessories.  For adding design detail, however,  a floor tile or even some contemporary wall tiles with a splash of contemporary color (in shades such as navy, steely blue or a subtle lime green) can achieve a stylish yet subtle result.  Using the Room tile in a toning color palette throughout the hall way and living rooms will create flow through the whole popular contemporary house.

Combining Different Tile Textures for a Unique Look

To create a truly individual and contemporary style living room,  try combining several different tile textures. This new style of design insular far beyond a simple contrasting color scheme. Combining several different textures provides a tactile element to your living room that would create an eye catching effect.  For example using smooth, large format vitrifIous tiles for the floor and textured wall tile with a tiny geometric pattern in a contrasting matte finish on an accent wall.  Combining an array of different textures, such as the gloss of the tiles used on the wall and the gleam of the floor tiles with the naturalness of the stone tiles,  can make a truly unique living room wall. Innovative designs such as these can really add individual spice to modern living rooms.

Tiles for Living Room Floors: What’s In Trend?

Modern trends in tiles for living room floors are always on the up,  for lifestyle and decorating purposes,  and can include stylistic and hard-wearing benefits.  The most popular choice is now tiles that come in larger sizes,  which within a living space give a remarkably smooth,  sleek, continuous ambiance. Wood effect tiles have been widely adopted in Indian homes and are still being used extensively as the natural warmth of timber combined with the easy to maintain qualities of both ceramic and porcelain becomes undeniably appealing. These days the preference is for matte finished floor tile creating a natural, plush, non-slip surface and contemporary ambiance.  Modern living room tiles are very durable to constant foot traffic and also include an area for stylish design, offering an atmospheric feature and high natural light whilst being able to easily be integrated with furniture and design.

Integrating Tiles into Living Room and Hall Designs

 

Open Concept Living Rooms: Seamless Transitions with Tiles

One of the best ways to create seamless transitions and merge between open concept living rooms is to use tiles; it helps to break down the walls between certain activation zones of large living spaces.  Using the same floor tile throughout the living room and hall area can be used to attain a wonderful modern look,  by using same color and surface to unite the place. Large format vitrified tiles with a matte surface are ideal in this situation,  as they are useful for living, hall areas that need a large seating space, and they also look quite elegant. Modern homes that come with open floor plans involve use of varied design ideas, but in case of tiles, the common factor is the choice of floor tile that can gel the entire space together.

Cozy Living Rooms: Using Tiles to Create Warmth

Tiles are usually linked to cool styles but should not be forgotten when it comes to cozy living rooms. They are very practical and can be incorporated into an inviting living room by using the right kind of room tile. Incorporating warm textured wall tiles on a wall to create a feature wall can really add to the warming hot feeling. Choosing to use textured floor tiles can also help to create a warm glow if they are in a matte finish to the tiles, as it reishes that it will absorb the light rather than reflect it.  Using a considerable variety of tiles and placing an emphasis on textures and colors can help make a contemporary interior design much warmer.

Indian Homes: Cultural Influences on Tile Choices

Cultural preferences are very much reflected in Indian homes. Since Indian homes reflect their age old taste for style and durability, tile options in Indian homes tend to be unique in their own way.  Elegant and classy residence tend to include vibrant colors and complicated geometric patterns in their tiled floor and living room wall tiles. Indian homes tend to have abundant designs of vitrified tiles for their durability and stability in their wide range of colors and designs. These tiles are also highly polish-able and easily maintenance is assured.  Vitrified tiles are usually high functioning tiles and are ideal for tile designs for living room. Several Indian homes tend to use natural stone tiles such as marble tiles to a lot of their home flooring designs. Multicolored marble tiles are very common in Indian homes.
